items.name: Recovery mid-build keeps the live view on the build
items.expected: Open `aether watch` during a live build/continue run, then trigger a recovery decision (e.g. force a worker failure). The build/continue episode and its active workers remain visible, with recovery state layered on top — not replaced by it.
items.reason: Owner does not use the second-terminal watch dashboard; wants colony visibility inline in the working terminal. Reported: "I never cared to have a second terminal window to view the colony stuff ... view within the one terminal that you're working"

items.name: A running Oracle round shows live in the watch dashboard
items.expected: Start a long-running Oracle round (`aether oracle iterate` or equivalent) and, from a second terminal, run `aether watch` while it is in progress. The dashboard shows the Oracle round live (current question, confidence, contradictions) rather than falling back to a replay-labelled summary.
items.reason: Same as test 1 - owner does not use the second-terminal watch dashboard.

items.name: Screens carry the Classic colony voice
items.expected: The rendered `aether watch` live dashboard, Swarm's end-of-investigation comparison card, and Oracle's synthesis document read as the Classic colony's own voice (caste emoji, ant glyphs, ceremony framing, Queen voice per D-04), not a generic status printout.
items.reason: Owner deferred - will test later; asked to mark the phase done.
